generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest reads this repository’s own index and writes a five-part tour: architecture, critical paths, run locally, reading path, and first tasks.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load the onboarding tour
loadError.body: The tour could not be read. Nothing else on this screen is affected — try again in a moment.

running.title: Writing the tour…
running.body: This takes up to a minute. The rest of the app stays usable; this screen updates itself when the tour is ready.

meta.filesSkipped: {count, plural, one {# file skipped} other {# files skipped}}

stale.title: The repository has moved on since this tour was written
stale.body: The index now sits at a newer commit than the one this tour recorded. What is below is still what was read then — regenerate it to describe the code as it is today.

partial.title: This tour was written from a partial index
partial.body: The sections below are real, but the index covered only part of this repository. What is here is true; what is missing proves nothing.

degraded.title: This is not a written tour
degraded.body: The sections below are the deterministic skeleton. They exist because a tour always has five sections, not because a tour could be written.

reason.flag_off: Codebase indexing is turned off for this workspace.
reason.index_failed: The last indexing run for this repository failed.
reason.index_partial: The repository index covers only part of this repository.
reason.repo_too_large: This repository is larger than the indexer’s file cap.
reason.index_missing: This repository has not been indexed yet.
reason.model_failed: The model call failed, so only the sections that need no model were written.
reason.model_timeout: The model did not answer within the time limit, so only the sections that need no model were written.
reason.model_invalid: The model’s answer did not match the shape this tour requires, so only the sections that need no model were written.
reason.no_commands_declared: No runnable command is declared in this repository’s package.json, Makefile or compose files, so none is shown rather than guessed.
reason.generic: The tour could not be completed, and the cause is not one this version of the screen recognises.

diagram.unavailable: The diagram for this section could not be rendered. The rest of the section is unaffected.

command.label: Commands
command.none: This repository declares no runnable command in the files this tour reads.
command.notRun: Nothing here is run for you — read the command against its file before you run it.

path.unavailable: No commit is recorded for this tour, so its files cannot be linked.
